payload.title: M2: A five-star Story is announced on X after one approval, within budget (MoM)
payload.description:
**Tasks:** PPY-9376f8 (budget stop, $10 default, merged #1840); PPY-9b8e59 (review deadline timers and the engine's own follow-up wakes, #1842); PPY-6af46b (model key rotation; the key expires about 1-4 December); PPY-1ea28b (#1777); PPY-817340 (wake guard live proof); the channel pause of PPY-3f68f4. Also: record the owner decisions in the design doc and board (suggestions only, $10 monthly default, system wakes without adoption) and re-parent PPY-eef85d, PPY-c023ab and PPY-8195a4 so their epics can close.

**Exit test (on MoM):** Ryan publishes a five-star Story; the draft is waiting, and overdue after its deadline with nobody looking; he approves and it is on @0nmachines within minutes; the Delivery reads sent; the spend page count rises by one; with the budget set below spend a paid run waits and one flag appears. Closes epic PPY-4bc313.
